verdict.rationale: Poly is an AI file-storage and 'second brain' product with Markdown journaling and note import, so wiki-style linking and backlinks is a fair axis for it. However, no evidence documents [[wiki-style]] links, backlinks, or unlinked-mention detection. Importing notes from Obsidian and natural-language search are adjacent features and do not deliver this capability.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can link notes with [[wiki-style]] links and see every backlink and unlinked mention of a note in context
